change: Record whether the beach creatures that hold Link on B15/C15/D15 (225-227/0) move when he pushes them, and how, so that a push could open the way to the door at (2,4) of D15 (stalls 4fc2 43344-49367 and 27ab from 26369).
verdict: Failed as a way out of the stall, because the creature is not what closes it. Type 197 (the urchin of B15 and C15) is pushable by one method: hold the shield (B) and walk straight into it. It then moves at about 1 px per 6 frames (1 px in 5 frames, 3 in 20, 9-10 in 60, 15-29 in 180 until something stops it) with no hp lost. With no shield, B alone, idle or a diagonal it moves 0-6 px, and Link loses 4 hp from the third frame. This holds on 2 root lineages, each with a no-shield control, so it is verified. Type 205 is not an urchin: it is the palm-top sprite at the four corners of D15, it hurts nobody, and its cells are solid with or without the slot. The left pocket of D15 is closed by the room objects 92 (0x5C) at (3,2) and (4,2). No push, with or without the shield, moved them or changed room_objects in 192 trials, and Link stops at x 28 on both lineages. So no push reaches the door, and a push fact cannot shrink this stall.
evidence: Census on throwaway copies of keyframes (RAM write to place Link, the entity census rule; not a capability trial). The probe is handoffs/KOHO-184/push_probe.rb in the Captain drive. Lineage roots from Bench.lineage_root: 20261127-224058-4fc2 and 20261127-134720-27ab, both from boot, so 2 lineages. States: 4fc2 at 48600 (B15, type 197 at (2,3)), 45000 (C15, 197 at (5,2)) and 46800 (D15, 205 at (1,0) and (5,0), objects at (3,2) and (4,2)); 27ab at 36000 (B15, 197 at (2,3)), 34200 (C15, 197 at (5,2)) and 39600 (D15, the same targets). Every target got 48 trials: each side x shield raised or lowered x held for 5, 20, 60 and 180 frames then 30 released, plus B alone and idle (60 frames) per side, and 4 diagonals x shield (60 frames). Each entity trial was repeated on a control copy with the slot cleared (the same cell with no creature). Type 197, shield and straight, on all 4 targets: 0-1 / 3 / 9-10 / 15-29 px at 5 / 20 / 60 / 180 frames, hp 0 on B15 (the C15 hits come from the second urchin at (6,2), present in the control too). With no shield: 0 px every time, hp -4 at frame 3, then -8 by 180 frames. B alone and idle: 0 px. Diagonal: at most 6 px, -4 hp in 7 of 8. In the control, Link walks 5 / 20 / 32-61 px in the same holds, so the push slows him to about a sixth of his walking speed, and the 0-4 px pushes seen in KOHO-150/167 are holds of 20 frames or less. Type 205 and objects 92: 0 px and 0 hp in every valid trial. Trials that put Link outside the room are dropped (12-14 per palm). Played position with no RAM write (4fc2 at 46800, Link at (24,80); 27ab at 39600, Link at (11,70)), each of 8 directions x B for 90 frames, with and without the four 205 slots: identical motion in 31 of 32 rows (the other is a 3 px difference during the scroll into C15). Moving right stops at x 28, against the objects. Cost: 0 USD, no model call, about 105,000 emulated frames, about 10 min of wall time on 2 processes.
